The '''sub-group hiding''' assumption is a computational hardness assumption used in [[elliptic curve cryptography]] and [[pairing-based cryptography]].

It was first introduced to build a [[Disjunctive normal form|2-DNF]] [[homomorphic encryption]] scheme.<ref>Dan Boneh, Eu-Jin Goh, Kobbi Nissim: Evaluating 2-DNF Formulas on Ciphertexts. TCC 2005: 325&ndash;341</ref>
